_: The realm's stories, one place (arcs.js, intrigue.js, view.js). maxActive: stories running at once; startChance: a season's chance a new one begins; cooldown: seasons before a story may begin again, when its file doesn't say (one third as often as before, Mac 2026-11-16); maxEach: stories one person can be caught up in at once; schemeSeasons: a scheme stays on the map this long after its last news; plagueSeasons: a town is still sick this many seasons after Freeciv's plague strikes it.
